spots.name: Greenmount / Rainbow Bay
spots.result:
DECISION: GO
QUALITY: 7/10
CONFIDENCE: HIGH

CONDITIONS
Wind: 11.2 knots from 8° (North-Northeast), offshore to cross-offshore at Greenmount/Rainbow Bay, resulting in clean wave faces.
Swell: Primary 1.16 m at 6.25 s from 82° (East-Northeast), providing a surfable wave with a moderate period, wrapping into the bay.
Wave height: Total 1.52 m, indicating overall wave energy, not breaking wave face height.

ASSESSMENT
Favourable offshore wind and an appropriately directed swell are generating clean, surfable waves. The swell's relatively short period of 6.25 s will result in less powerful waves that are more closely spaced.

BOARD
Performance shortboard for manoeuvrability and to generate speed from the shorter-period waves.

BEST WINDOW
A reliable time window cannot be determined from the available data.

BOTTOM LINE
Conditions justify a surf for most surfers seeking clean, rideable waves.
